evidence_class: selection-aware reciprocal embryo-disjoint development OOF; not untouched confirmation

hypotheses.primary: Eight-view inverse-aligned U-Net feature averaging improves the fixed weak learned/motion linker relative to compute-matched eight-view detection with identity-view features.
hypotheses.secondary_diagnostic: Expanding detector-logit TTA from the existing four views to the full eight-view D4 group improves the fixed coordinate-only registered policy relative to EXP190. This is reported separately and cannot rescue a failed primary feature-TTA gate.

fixed_protocol.movies: All 24 already-open development movies: 12 6bba targets of the 44b6-trained scratch model and 12 44b6 targets of the 6bba-trained scratch model.
fixed_protocol.models: Exact EXP130 deterministic 44b6 scratch checkpoint forward and exact EXP137 seed-314159 6bba scratch checkpoint reverse.
fixed_protocol.selection: none; all parameters and both comparisons are fixed before inference

mandatory_controls: Candidate source differs from the frozen parent only inside the detector/feature TTA block and parses successfully.
All seven non-identity D4 transforms and inverse maps restore a synthetic non-square grid exactly.
The cached fixed weak-linker evaluator must reproduce the original registered_weak_hungarian arm at minimum length 1 within 1e-12 before EXP207 inference.
Within EXP207, feature-off and feature-on caches must have exact coordinate arrays for every movie.
Coordinate-only registered metrics must be exactly equal between feature-off and feature-on arms.
At least one learned edge probability or selected weak link must differ, proving the feature arm was active.
